reasoningChain.evidence: The active goal is continued progression, and increasing direct damage is the preferred way to shorten future fights.
Across two wins the barricade militia has been one of the weakest contributors and ranked fourth in the latest fight with only 4.32% damage.
The newly unlocked mage is visibly described as a complete output hero for clearing and burst.
The mage can legally replace the barricade militia in slot one.
Replacing the proven rank-one warrior would discard the main damage source; replacing the rank-four barricade militia trades the least observed damage for a complete output hero.
If the mage is a real output upgrade over the barricade militia, it should finish the next combat within the top two damage ranks.

hypothesis.problem: The team contains a repeatedly weak damage contributor before the next main encounter.
hypothesis.cause: The barricade militia contributes little direct damage while the full mage is presented as an output specialist.
